decision.section: Iterate - feature: operator-started real end-to-end run through the WebUI
decision.title: Operator-run Playwright spec project beside a hashed package
decision.context: No test shows whether a Brief package becomes a working chat-first app when a person drives it through the WebUI; a real run costs tokens and varies, so it cannot gate CI.
decision.decision: A Node/Playwright project at integration-tests/e2e-webui drives a second WebUI instance and writes a screenshot report; CI checks only package validation, the dry harness and structure rules. The answer key sits beside the package.
decision.consequences: The operator keeps the WebUI test ids current; npm run typecheck and test:unit are its only guards. The first real run is operator acceptance. Openai architecture reject overridden (scope fixed by the brief).
decision.rationale: A screenshot report from a real run is the only evidence a package works end to end; a key inside the package would change its hash and let the builder read it.
decision.rejected: Manual procedure only (no repeatable report); doing nothing (question stays open); answer key inside the package.

changelog.bullet: Operator-started end-to-end spec project (integration-tests/e2e-webui) that drives the WebUI with a real agent from the social engagement Brief package, with an answer-key checklist and a screenshot report; CI checks the package and the project's structure

behaviors.behavior: package validates against its recorded hash and the answer key stays outside the hashed package
checklist has hard and soft items with unique ids the spec records
behaviors.evidence: test_e2e_webui_project.py::test_checklist_has_hard_and_soft_items_with_unique_ids PASSED; unit: the committed checklist has hard and soft items PASSED

behaviors.behavior: no defaults for permission mode, webui dir and budget; refusal names the missing input
behaviors.evidence: unit config.spec.ts: refuses to start without each required input PASSED; test_operator_inputs_have_no_defaults_and_children_use_fixed_argv PASSED

behaviors.behavior: env file read only for unset variables, real environment wins, source recorded
behaviors.evidence: unit config.spec.ts: the real environment wins over the env file PASSED

behaviors.behavior: copied login is deleted, stale copies scrubbed without touching a live run, one idempotent shutdown
behaviors.evidence: unit config.spec.ts: copied login removed; shutdown runs every step once; stale login copies scrubbed PASSED

behaviors.behavior: temp HOME gets real plugins, permission mode and folder trust; child env points every home location at it
behaviors.evidence: unit config.spec.ts: provisioning writes ...; child env points every home-like location PASSED

behaviors.behavior: report renders from the template, links screenshots, survives a failing screenshot; idle watch
behaviors.evidence: unit report.spec.ts: report and idle watch tests PASSED

behaviors.behavior: hard chat checks and project file checks pass a faithful app/project and fail a broken one
behaviors.evidence: unit report.spec.ts: chat hard checks...; project file checks... PASSED

behaviors.behavior: every .ts file stays within 300 lines; fixed argv; .gitignore and .env.example names only
a real agent run through the WebUI turns the package into a working app
behaviors.reason: needs a real model session and the WebUI; this is the operator acceptance run outside the campaign

finalize.reason: iterate: operator-started real end-to-end run through the WebUI
